source.name: CUAD v1 (Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset)
source.citation: Hendrycks, Burns, Chen and Ball. CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks.

dataset_card.split_method: filing-company groups, stratified by contract type, 70/15/15 by contract count

ensemble_minilm_logreg - tfidf_logreg (macro F1, all test clauses)
ensemble_minilm_logreg - transformer_minilm (macro F1, all test clauses)
ensemble_minilm_logreg - tfidf_linear_svm (macro F1, all test clauses)

ood_reference_templates.note: clauses of data/standard_documents/standard_*.txt with a manual category in categories.json
